exposure: Respectful maternity care (RMC) training of health care providers
outcome: Respectful maternity care (measured by Person-centered maternity care (PCMC) scale score)
Birth satisfaction (measured by birth satisfaction scale-revised (BSSR) scales)
cohort: A total of 200 women undergoing normal vaginal birth were enrolled (100 in pre-intervention and 100 in post-intervention phases).
finding: The study found a significant improvement in both respectful maternity care and birth satisfaction scores in women whose healthcare providers had received RMC training.
